points.point: Wi-Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be raises PHY demands to 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams and 4096 QAM, and MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment essential
points.label: covered
points.why: states 320 MHz, 4096QAM, 16 streams, MLO, multi-RF/MIMO need

points.point: Wi-Fi 8 retains Wi-Fi 7 core PHY parameters — frequencies up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM, MLO — so frequency/bandwidth coverage requirements carry over
points.label: covered
points.why: states Wi-Fi 8 retains 7.125 GHz, 320 MHz, 4096QAM, MLO

points.point: Wi-Fi 8 introduces new measurement types: dRU measurements (verifying uplink transmit power boost / reliability against PSD limits) and UEQM analysis (per-MIMO-link modulation adaptation vs specified MCS combinations)
points.label: partial
points.why: covers dRU and UEQM, but omits PSD-limit aspect for dRU

points.point: Multi-channel hardware is required: CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO in one box, and two units scale to four analyzers/generators for 4x4 MIMO APs
points.label: partial
points.why: covers CMP180 2 analyzers/generators and 2x2, omits two units for 4x4 APs

points.point: Production-side instrument capability is stated as non-cellular coverage up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz, and a 480 MHz WLAN waveform verified in loopback as a potential (not yet standardized) Wi-Fi 8 candidate
points.label: covered
points.why: states up to 8 GHz, 500 MHz, and 480 MHz as nonstandard candidate/loopback context

points.point: Signaling-tester measurement bandwidth is enumerated per standard and currently reaches 320 MHz for WLAN
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions CMX500/signaling and 320 MHz generally, not enumerated WLAN bandwidth list

points.point: On the signal analyzer, each new WLAN generation needs its own measurement application option plus sufficient analysis bandwidth options (e.g. FSWX KM412 for 802.11be, KM414 for 802.11bn, both on top of KM410; B320 for 320 MHz analysis bandwidth)
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions analyzer bandwidth options like B320, omits FSWX KM412/KM414/KM410 apps

points.point: On the signal generator, wide internal RF modulation bandwidth and 802.11be waveform/EVM options are the stated enablers for future WLAN requirements
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions wide RF modulation bandwidth, omits 802.11be waveform/EVM option details
